Name: Auto Talk To Everyone
Author: 2mango
Description:
[b]English Description[/b][b]Tired of spending entire in-game hours trekking across the map? This mod allows you to greet every villager you know with a single key press, no matter where they are.
[/b]
[b]How it works:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Activation Key:[/b] Press [b]L[/b] to say hello to everyone instantly.
[*][b]Effect:[/b] The mod automatically finds all NPCs you’ve met and triggers their daily conversation (+20 friendship points).
[*][b]Global Reach:[/b] Works across all locations — from Pelican Town to the Desert and Ginger Island.
[*][b]Feedback:[/b] You will hear a "coin/chime" sound, and a message will appear in the bottom-left corner showing exactly how many villagers you’ve successfully talked to.
[/list][b]Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]No "Cheating":[/b] If you’ve already spoken to someone in person, the mod won't grant double friendship points.
[*][b]Smart Logic:[/b] If you’ve already talked to everyone for the day, pressing the button will play a sound and notify you that there's no one left to greet.
[*][b]Full Localization:[/b] Supports both English and Russian
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Auto Talk Mod
Manifest.Description: Talk to all villagers across the map with one key press
Manifest.Author: 2mango
